source.title: Problème de Mordell-Lang modulo certaines sous-variétés abéliennes

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 1995142.

The zbMATH document page could not be read directly in the available browser/fetch environment, and local shell fetches failed because DNS/network access is unavailable in the sandbox. Exact identifier searches identified the same work as MR 1995142 / Zbl 1072.11038, by Gaël Rémond and Evelina Viada, with DOI 10.1155/S1073792803130164.

The DOI landing page resolved to the Oxford Academic record, which exposed only bibliographic metadata and an abstract, marked the article as available for purchase, and stated that the content is only available as a PDF. This was treated as metadata/abstract-only rather than readable primary full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact DOI, exact title plus PDF, the repository file name 2003-35-1915.pdf, and author-title combinations. Inspected candidates were the University of Basel edoc metadata page advertising a PDF, the Oxford purchase/minimal page, the author bibliography, and citing/reference pages; none yielded a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source in the available environment.
